findings.why: Viteria Lanzo is not in the supplier master, has no id and has no qualification record. Purchasing must say who the supplier is and whether an audit exists.

sources.quote: A supplier may deliver a part only if the approved supplier list contains an approval for that supplier, that part, the receiving site and the customer.

findings.why: The approved supplier list covers HB-620 for PLT-PIN and CUST-NOR, and it holds no approval for Viteria Lanzo. The only current approval is for SUP-H, and the SUP-D approval was revoked. Lanzo therefore has no release for this part.

sources.quote: A change of source or a change of material requires Nordhavn approval (PPAP resubmission) before the first shipment.

findings.why: HB-620 belongs to PRG-Y, whose customer is Nordhavn. A new casting source is a change of source, so Nordhavn's written approval (PPAP) is needed before the first shipment. No approval for Lanzo is on file.

sources.quote: A change of source requires a material certificate (EN 10204 type 3.1) from the new supplier for the drawing material. Missing certificates are an open question for the supplier quality engineer.

findings.why: No 3.1 certificate for MAT-ALSI9CU3 from Viteria Lanzo is on file. The supplier quality engineer (E. Gallo) must follow this up.
